info.name: TradeNexa APIs
info.description:
# TradeNexa API Collection

Complete REST reference for the TradeNexa B2B marketplace backend.

## Quick start

1. Set collection variable `base_url` → `http://localhost:3000/api/v1`
2. Set `socket_url` → `http://localhost:3000` (Socket.IO only)
3. Run **Auth → Send OTP → Verify OTP** (or **Admin Auth → Admin Login**)
4. Tokens are auto-saved into `access_token` / `buyer_token` / `seller_token` / `admin_token` when test scripts are present
5. Use the matching Bearer token on protected requests

## Response shape

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "…",
  "data": {},
  "errors": []
}
```

List endpoints return `data.results` + `data.pagination` (`page`, `limit`, `total`, `totalPages`). `limit` max is **100**.

## Auth

| Flow | How |
|------|-----|
| Buyer / seller phone OTP | `POST /auth/send-otp` → `verify-otp` → tokens or `registration_token` |
| New user | `POST /auth/register` with Bearer `registration_token` |
| Profile completion | `PUT /auth/profile` multipart (`category_id` required) |
| Admin panel | `POST /admin/auth/login` email + password |
| Refresh | `POST /auth/refresh-token` |

**Roles:** `buyer` · `seller` · `buyer_seller` · `admin` · `super_admin` · `supporter`

## Modules in this collection

| Folder | Prefix | Notes |
|--------|--------|-------|
| Auth & Profile | `/auth` | OTP, register, profile CRUD |
| Locations | `/locations` | Countries → states → cities |
| Admin Auth | `/admin/auth` | Panel login + create admin users |
| Roles | `/roles` | Role list for registration |
| Business Types | `/business-types` | Filtered by `role_id` |
| Categories & Subcategories | `/categories` | Main + nested subcategories |
| Banners | `/banners` | Home banners |
| Products | `/products` | Catalog, seller CRUD, approval, search history |
| Wishlist | `/wishlist` | Buyer wishlist |
| Sellers | `/sellers` | Directory + public seller products |
| Brands / Offers | `/brands` `/offers` | Catalog extras |
| RFQs | `/rfqs` | Public, buyer, seller feed, quotations, admin |
| Inquiries | `/inquiries` | Product inquiry → quote flow |
| Chat | `/chats` | REST inbox + messages (see Socket.IO below) |
| Notifications | `/notifications` | In-app inbox + FCM-related dismiss sync |
| Dashboard | `/dashboard` | Seller KPIs + admin platform metrics |
| Services / News | `/services` `/news` | Content modules |

## Socket.IO (realtime)

- URL: `{{socket_url}}` path `/socket.io`
- Auth: `handshake.auth.token` = access JWT (or `Authorization: Bearer`)
- Used for chat messages, typing, presence, unread badges, notification unread

## Conventions

- **REQUIRED / OPTIONAL** tables are in each request description
- Path params use collection variables (`{{product_id}}`, `{{rfq_id}}`, …)
- Prefer `role=buyer|seller` on chat / notifications for dual-role accounts
- Seller RFQ feed defaults to profile `category_id` and always includes assigned PRIVATE RFQs
- Do not send image URLs as text for multipart file fields — upload the file

## Health (outside collection)

`GET {{socket_url}}/health` → server liveness (not under `/api/v1`).

item.name: Auth & Profile

request.description:
POST /auth/send-otp — Send OTP to mobile for login/registration.

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|-------|----------|------|-------------|
| `mobile_number` | REQUIRED | string | E.164 format with country code e.g. +919876543210 |
| `recaptcha_token` | OPTIONAL | string | Optional reCAPTCHA token |

POST /auth/verify-otp — Verify OTP. Returns access_token (existing user) or registration_token (new user).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|-------|----------|------|-------------|
| `mobile_number` | REQUIRED | string | Same mobile used in send-otp |
| `otp` | REQUIRED | string | 6-digit OTP from SMS/Firebase |
| `firebase_verification_id` | REQUIRED | string | Firebase verification session ID |
| `device_type` | OPTIONAL | string | android | ios | web |
| `device_token` | OPTIONAL | string | FCM/push device token |

POST /auth/resend-otp — Resend OTP.

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|-------|----------|------|-------------|
| `mobile_number` | REQUIRED | string | E.164 format |
| `firebase_verification_id` | REQUIRED | string | From prior send-otp response |
| `recaptcha_token` | OPTIONAL | string | Optional reCAPTCHA |

POST /auth/refresh-token — Get new access token.

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|-------|----------|------|-------------|
| `refresh_token` | REQUIRED | string | Valid refresh token from login |

POST /auth/logout — Invalidate refresh token. Requires Bearer access_token.

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|-------|----------|------|-------------|
| `refresh_token` | OPTIONAL | string | Refresh token to revoke |

POST /auth/register — Complete registration after OTP (Bearer registration_token).

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|-------|----------|------|-------------|
| `mobile_number` | REQUIRED | string | E.164 format — must match verified mobile |
| `full_name` | REQUIRED | string | 2-100 characters |
| `email` | REQUIRED | string | Valid email address |
| `role_id` | REQUIRED | integer | Role ID — buyer {{buyer_role_id}}, seller {{seller_role_id}} |
| `business_type_id` | REQUIRED | integer | From GET /business-types?role_id= |
| `language_id` | OPTIONAL | integer | Defaults to English if omitted |
| `device_type` | OPTIONAL | string | android | ios | web |
| `device_token` | OPTIONAL | string | Push notification token |

GET /auth/profile — Authenticated user profile + badge counts.

**Auth:** Bearer `{{access_token}}`.

**Profile fields (role-dependent):** company, address, `category_id` + nested `category`, GST/PAN, etc.

**`data.counts`:**
- `wishlist`
- `notifications_unread` → `{ total, buyer, seller }`
- `chat_unread` → `{ total, as_buyer, as_seller }`
- `inquiries` / `rfqs` → `as_buyer` / `as_seller` status breakdowns
